koch.definition: n. German bacteriologist who isolated the anthrax bacillus and the tubercle bacillus and the cholera bacillus (1843-1910)

koch flask.translation: [化] 科赫瓶; 科赫培养瓶

koch's acid.translation: [化] 科赫酸; α-萘胺-3,6,8-三磺酸

koch's bacillus.translation: [医] 郭霍氏杆菌(结核杆菌)

koch's law.translation: [医] 郭霍氏定律, 郭霍氏要点(确定病原体的四要点)

koch's lymph.translation: [医] 郭霍氏浆苗, 结核菌素

koch's node.translation: [医] 郭霍氏结, 房室结

koch's phenomenon.translation: [医] 郭霍氏现象(结核菌再感染剧烈反应)

koch's reaction.translation: [医] 郭霍氏反应, 结核菌素反应

koch's tests.translation: [医] 郭霍氏试验(检出血性素质)

koch-ehrlich stain.translation: [医] 郭-欧二氏染剂(染血细胞)

koch-weeks bacillus.translation: [医] 郭-威二氏杆菌, 结膜炎[嗜血]杆菌

kochb's postulates.translation: [医] 郭霍氏要点(确定病原体的四要点)

kocher.translation: 克歇尔(Emil Theodor, 1841-1917, 瑞士生理学家、病理学家、外科医师, 曾获1909年诺贝尔生理学-医学奖)

kocher's dilatation ulcer.translation: [医] 柯赫尔氏扩张处溃疡(肠异常扩张及肠梗阻过程中并发的溃疡)

kocher's forceps.translation: [医] 柯赫尔氏钳(手术时夹持组织或压出血组织用)

kocher's incision.translation: [医] 柯赫尔氏切口(胆囊手术时右侧肋弓下的切开法)

kocher's points.translation: [医] 柯赫尔氏点(穿刺侧脑室点)

kocher's reflex.translation: [医] 柯赫尔氏反射, 睾丸腹肌反射

kocher's sign.translation: [医] 柯赫尔氏征, 柯赫尔氏症状

kocher's symptom.translation: [医] 柯赫尔氏症状(突眼性甲状腺肿患者眼上视时,上睑跳起较眼球为快)

kochi.translation: vt. 高知县（日本四国岛中南岸港市）；科钦（位于印度）

kochia.translation:
n. 地肤
[网络] 地肤属；碱地肤

kochins.translation: (kochin 的复数) n. (Kochin)人名；(俄)科钦

kochsucker.definition:
One who sucks the proverbial cock of the billionaire Koch brothers. Bonus points for also being a 'sucker' by falling for a prank call from someone posing as a Koch brother.
> Hey, are you voting to re-elect Scott Walker?
> No way! He's a dirty, rotten Kochsucker!

kock.translation: [人名] 科克; [地名] [波兰] 科茨克

kocks' operation.translation: [医] 科克斯氏手术(子宫阔韧带减缩术)
